messages:
Anna (Docs): Quick thread — I'm assembling the short release blurb for the next docs deploy (targeting 0.10.0). Need: 1) final user-facing bullets, 2) any known issues we must surface, 3) SDK snippet updates + links. I'll push a PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421
Marco (Eng): Re: SDK snippets — FYI I changed the text-generation example to the v2 client signature. Please swap the old `client.generate()` snippet in the API overview. Example: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.text.generate(model="kestrel-v1", prompt="Summarize...")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Lena (DX): Thanks — sending a tiny PR now to update the snippet and add a short note about streaming compatibility. Will also run link-checker.
Sam (Release): Heads-up: can we keep the release blurb to 3 bullets max and one short "known issues" line? Marketing wants a single-sentence lead for the product page. Also, tagging the staging deploy window: 3pm PT today.
Anna (Docs): Good call. Draft bullets: 
- Improved routing policy: auto-fallback to compatible model variants under capacity pressure (faster failover)
- Cost controls: new quantization suggestion panel in Redwood Optimize
- Dev DX: small SDK API consistency updates + streaming stability improvements
Known issue (short): Some dedicated clusters may show transient 500s on rare cache eviction patterns; we recommend rollbacks to previous model variant if you see repeated failures.
Marco (Eng): Adding: the 500s are limited to older runtime images (pre 2026-03-01). Newer images include a guard to reduce exceptions. If you want a one-liner: "Known issue: older dedicated runtime images may surface transient 500s under stress; upgrade to runtime >= 2026-03-01."
Lena (DX): Link checklist for PR: 
- Update SDK snippets in `/reference/sdk` and `/guides/migrations`
- Add redirect for old `generate()` example
- Run internal link-checker: `tools/linkcheck --path docs --ignore /experimental`
(Posting PR in a sec)
Anna (Docs): Pasted a candidate blurb into the PR description and left the short YAML frontmatter for the changelog: ```yaml
changelog: |
  - Auto-fallback routing to compatible model variants (reduced failover time)
  - Quantization suggestions added to Redwood Optimize
  - SDK: v2 client examples and streaming improvements
known_issues: |
  - Older dedicated runtime images (pre 2026-03-01) may show transient 500s during cache eviction; recommend upgrade or temporary rollback.
```
Sam (Release): Looks good. @deploy-bot can you kick the docs staging deploy after Lena's snippet PR merges? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deployment queued — staging docs deploy scheduled at 15:05 PT. Will post status here when finished.
Ryan (Product): Quick wording tweak request: in the first bullet, change "auto-fallback" -> "automatic fallback" and add "(reduces downtime)" at the end. Otherwise approved from PM.
Anna (Docs): Updated the PR description per Ryan, shortened the lead sentence for marketing. Lena, once your snippet PR is merged, I'll do a final pass and then merge the relnotes entry. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
